falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent would invalidate the bottom pattern match, proving this was not a structural bottom but rather a bear market continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained volatility expansion above the August 2024 panic threshold would indicate the current stabilization is false, confirming distribution rather than accumulation and invalidating the bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts by more than -50 basis points (i.e., 2Y yield exceeds 10Y yield by 0.50% or more)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening recessionary signal beyond the August 2024 regime would prove the macro backdrop has deteriorated structurally, making the 75% pattern match to a 'bottom' scenario statistically invalid as the fundamental conditions have shifted

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
